def resample(t, tp, vp, use_avg=False):
    utils.assert_valid_stepfun(tp, vp)

        widths = jnp.diff(tp)

        resampled_product = jnp.interp(t, tp, product)

        # Resample the widths into t
        resampled_widths = jnp.interp(t, tp, widths)

        # Compute the weighted average
        v = resampled_product / resampled_widths
    else:
        # Compute the cumulative sum of vp
        acc = jnp.cumsum(vp, axis=-1)

        # Prepend a zero to the cumulative sum
        acc0 = jnp.concatenate([[0], acc[:, :-1]], axis=-1)

        # Interpolate acc0 at points defined by t
        resampled_values = jnp.vectorize(jnp.interp, signature='(n),(m)->(n)')(t, tp, acc0)

        # Compute the difference between adjacent interpolated values
        v = jnp.diff(resampled_values, axis=-1)
